title: Bounded motion-aware radial-scale search after static close-camera holdout rejection
question: Can a smooth, monotonic radial-scale path preserve the D4 occlusion fix while preventing the corrected subject from growing beyond the unchanged geometry template across the close shot?
hypothesis: At least one candidate with radial scale 2.0 at the shot start and a larger end scale will pass the unchanged geometry template on all nine exposed derivation frames while remaining monotonic and changing by at most 0.02 scale units per integer frame.

cameraFamily.transform: For evaluated source camera position C and target T, set C'=T+Matrix.Rotation(-45 degrees, Z)@(C-T)*s(frame), then track -Z to T with Y up.

derivation.baselineReproduction: RS_S200_E200 must reproduce the retained D3 selected-candidate observations at frames 216/240/264 and retained D4 corrected observations at frames 193/204/228/252/276/288 within 1e-9 for compared floats and exactly for discrete fields.
derivation.candidateFeasibleWhen: The candidate passes the complete unchanged template on all nine derivation frames, is monotonic nondecreasing, and its maximum adjacent integer-frame scale delta is at most 0.02.
selectionOrder: minimum mean absolute per-frame scale deviation from 2.0 across frames 193 through 288

sealedValidation.exclusionFromD5: Neither D5 Blender search process nor its Node auditor may evaluate, project, ray-cast, render or derive feasibility on these frames.
sealedValidation.futureUse: Only a later preregistered fresh-scene paired Cycles validation may unseal them after the D5 candidate, if any, is frozen and pushed.

independentImplementation.sharedNumericPrimitive: Both implementations use Blender mathutils.Matrix.Rotation for the frozen world-Z rotation; all traversal, projection, roster and selection code remains independently authored.
independentImplementation.agreement: Candidate IDs, frame rosters, feasibility, selected candidate and discrete fields exact; compared finite floats within 1e-9.

sequence: Commit and push this spec, protocol and journal while all four tools and the D5 root are absent.
Implement and statically validate all four tools without evaluating sealed frames.
Commit and push exact tool bytes.
Create fresh admission, run two Blender searches, then run the independent Node audit. Retain every failure.

output.immutableFailurePolicy: Any failure preserves all partial outputs and requires a separately preregistered correction plus a fresh root.

decision.supportedWhen: Both independent searches agree, the static baseline reproduces retained evidence and fails, at least one motion-aware candidate passes all nine derivation frames, the selected candidate follows the frozen order, sealed frames remain unobserved and every process/resource gate passes.
decision.rejectedWhen: The complete admitted candidate family is evaluated correctly but no motion-aware candidate passes all nine derivation frames.
decision.invalidated: Any parent, tool, runtime, process, baseline-reproduction, candidate-roster, independent-agreement, resource or sealed-frame boundary failure yields scientificVerdict null.

nonClaims: D5 is a zero-render derivation search and cannot admit image quality or cinematic merit.
A derivation candidate cannot be promoted until a later fresh-scene paired Cycles experiment passes the eight sealed validation frames.
The grid does not optimize arbitrary camera motion, target position, lens, sensor, shift, depth of field or storytelling preference.
The unchanged 0.90 maximum may not be relaxed after any D5 observation.
